title: Githyanki Egg

sources.title: Steal a Githyanki Egg
markers: | description = Steal a Githyanki Egg is a Quest in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Lady Esther at the Mountain Pass.

summary: Take the egg from the Crèche Y’llek Hatchery to Lady Esther for the quest, or keep it.

fields.Acquisition: The Hatchery is protected by acid and traps. Speak with Varsh Ko’kuu to obtain permission or take the egg yourself.
fields.Keeping the egg: Lae’zel can carry the egg. Storing it in the Traveller’s Chest can make Lae’zel respond as though it was lost.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
